value.rationale: Quantifies a sharp gap between almost-sure 2-sample observability and unconditional finite mean-squared noisy reconstruction requiring at least four iid observations. The coefficient is a useful sampling design diagnostic depending on the mth-power concentration of the phase density, and its strict minimizer provides a principled leading-tail design choice. This is a structural control/estimation risk, not a routine numerical count.
